firstPlayerRule: The most recent person to board a real train starts and takes the miniature whistle. Play goes clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After each round of players' turns, the person who acted last takes the whistle and starts the next round.
